validation.notes: DO NOT SHIP AS-IS. 93MB, ~6x over the 15MB hero-asset target - this is a full-atomic-detail cryo-EM surface mesh (single color-by-chain print-oriented mesh), not decimated for real-time rendering. A non-bychain single-color variant (310727) was also probed and is still 84MB, so the size is inherent to the source resolution, not the color variant. Needs an aggressive decimation/retopology pass (Blender decimate or Draco-compressed low-poly re-export) before this can be a mobile-safe Ribosome hero asset. Kept on disk as the only correctly-licensed high-fidelity source found; treat as a raw-material asset for a follow-up processing wave, not a ship-ready asset. Not render-inspected visually in this pass.
